info.name: HustleHub+ | Part 2 Secure Stack
info.description: Run top-to-bottom in one go via Newman (npm run test:postman), which seeds a demo gig and starts two isolated HTTPS servers automatically — no manual copy/paste of ids or tokens required. Folder 01 regenerates Part 1's auth coverage. Folder 02 (Gigs) is Daniel's and is expected to fail with 404 until his gig routes are merged — everything from folder 03 onward only depends on Person 1's models/auth and Person 3's own code, so it should pass today. Folders 03-05 are Person 3's bookings/transactions/income/RBAC coverage. Folder 06 proves the booking rate limiter against a second, isolated server so earlier booking traffic in this run can never change the outcome. Trust certs/localhost.pem in Postman before running manually. All credentials are disposable test data.

item.name: 05 - Errors never leak stack traces or secrets

exec: pm.test('No credentials leaked', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); const user = json.data && json.data.user; if (user) { pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); } pm.expect(json).not.to.have.property('stack'); });

pm.test('No stack/secret leakage', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).not.to.match(/at [A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+ \(/); pm.expect(text.toLowerCase()).not.to.include('mongodb+srv'); });
